newsitem.title: UK: ICI fined over chemical leak.
newsitem.headline: ICI fined over chemical leak.

text.p: Imperial Chemical Industries Plc has been fined 15,000 stg after a chemical leak at its Runcorn site in north-west England, Britain's Environment Agency said on Friday.
The agency said Runcorn magistrates fined ICI Chemicals and Polymers Ltd and ordered it to pay more than 5,000 in costs over an ethylene dichloride leak last July.
The agency said the chemical was sprayed horizonatally for about 10 metres after a hose blew off during a refit at the plant, with around 29 kilograms of it flowing into the Weston Canal.

The Agency said ICI pleaded guilty to breaching two conditions of its license for vinyl chloride at Runcorn Magistrates Court. The Agency said it "views the incident as serious and one which could have been avoided."
